name: Selfre -Self Friend-
original_name: セルフレ -セルフフレンド-
source:
Shinobu is part of the camera club, which is lacking members other than him and the club leader Umi. One day, a close-up selfie focused on the large cleavage was posted on a website he runs. He thought that it looked like that of the honours student Ai, and she unwillingly admitted to taking the picture when he approached her about it. Surprisingly, instead of using it as blackmail, he reprimanded her for taking poor pictures. He offered to capture her beauty and she agreed, having been talked to in such a way for the first time.

The photos that Shinobu took of her were certainly quite attractive and were extremely well-received when they were uploaded online. After many photo shoots, they both began to get aroused and it soon led to sex. There were also many fine subjects at the school: the big-breasted beauty Umi; quiet but sometimes S kouhai Eri; the strong-willed but easily teased news club member Oruha; and, dreamy tomboy Io who knows his relationship with Ai. Which one of them will he capture next?
